import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Define column names for readability
unitary_authority = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)'
rank_aspect_1 = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).2'
rank_aspect_2 = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).4'
rank_aspect_3 = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).8'

# Prepare data for plotting
x = df[unitary_authority]
y1 = df[rank_aspect_1]
y2 = df[rank_aspect_2]
y3 = df[rank_aspect_3]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
plt.bar(x, y1, label='Rank Aspect 1')
plt.bar(x, y2, bottom=y1, label='Rank Aspect 2')
plt.bar(x, y3, bottom=y1 + y2, label='Rank Aspect 3')

plt.title('Comparison of Different Deprivation Ranks across Unitary Authorities')
plt.xlabel('Unitary Authority')
plt.ylabel('Rank Value')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
